title: DesignIntentResponse
description: Canonical superset schema for the DesignIntent model response: the six design fields plus a non-design `presentation` object. The application splits the response into DesignIntent (six fields, consumed by the compiler) and ConceptPresentation (name/description, never read by the compiler). At runtime narrow hard-assignment/catalog enums before sending to the structured-output provider.

heroArchetype.description: Must exactly match the deterministic assignment. Runtime schema should narrow this enum to one value.

tonalDirection.description: Must exactly match the deterministic assignment. Runtime schema should narrow this enum to one value.

colors.description: Creative source palette only. 3-5 unique uppercase #RRGGBB colors.

dominant.description: Must exactly equal one member of colors. Enforce with post-schema semantic validation.

typographyPairing.description: Semantic pairing ID, not raw font names. Runtime schema must narrow this enum to pairings allowed for the assigned archetype + typography category.

motifs.description: Motif requests only. Runtime schema should narrow to motifs compatible with the assigned archetype's available slot roles.

presentation.description: Non-design presentation metadata shown to the host on concept cards. The compiler never reads it.

name.description: Two or three Title Case words evoking the concept's character. Not an archetype/enum ID, not a brand name, not a tone-plus-archetype template.

description.description: One sentence describing how the concept feels, in host-facing language. No renderer or implementation terms.
